messages.author: 26522826f49c0886
messages.subject: Error in Depolying a Developed Shiny Apps:‏
parts:
Hi all,

I am deploying a developed Apps (already passed test on local machine) onto ShinyApps.io, but it returns an error message on the command line:
===
Preparing to deploy application...DONE
Uploading bundle for application: 76381... : 
Unable to retrieve package records for the following packages: "dichromat", "labeling"
===
Then I added "library(dichromat); library(labeling)" on the server.R, but it does not work. Has anyone met such error before or any solution to it? Thanks a lot. Best regards.

Yours,
Ben

messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Error in Depolying a Developed Shiny Apps:
parts:
Hi Ben,

packrat doesn't support R-Forge without additional configuration, so if you uninstall and re-install the packages from CRAN instead it should just work.
It is possible that doing something like:

options(repos = c("R-Forge" = "https://R-Forge.R-project.org", CRAN="https://cran.rstudio.com"))

will work, but that is untested and YMMV.

Hi Joshua,

I deleted and tried reinstalling packrat as below:
===
install.packages("packrat", repos=c("R-Forge"="https://R-Forge.R-project.org", CRAN="https://cran.rstudio.com"))
===
But it just halted there, so I downloaded and installed the packrat.zip from https://cran.rstudio.com/. But it does not work yet, same problem as before.
 
-Ben

From: j...@rstudio.com
Date: Mon, 28 Mar 2016 14:32:46 +0000
Subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Error in Depolying a Developed Shiny Apps:
To: bme....@gmail.com; shinyap...@googlegroups.com

Hi Ben,

packrat doesn't support R-Forge without additional configuration, so if you uninstall and re-install the packages from CRAN instead it should just work.
It is possible that doing something like:

options(repos = c("R-Forge" = "https://R-Forge.R-project.org", CRAN="https://cran.rstudio.com"))

will work, but that is untested and YMMV.
